title: THE BIG MINIMAP AND LARGE HUD NO LONGER PUT PANELS OVER THE BELT
why: Queue job 242 (CEO 10-29, from the o-00q camera at v36.41): with the minimap at its biggest size, the player 2 large HUD and run info open, the run info column covered the belt keys and the air strike meter, and the player 2 belt covered the end of the contract feed line. The run info now stops one gap above the belt and the air strike meter (it keeps the top rows and ends with a plus n more line), and a feed line that stands level with the belt ends before the belt.
now: Run info stops above the belt keys and the air strike meter in a crowded setup, and feed lines end before the belt.
